reason: An educational paper-reading agent for Chinese-speaking learners that extracts and analyzes PDF or LaTeX research materials, explains papers, and can optionally use a vision endpoint for figure interpretation.

summaries.zh: 面向中文读者的英文论文精读插件，可提取和解析 PDF、LaTeX 及图表内容，并按不同深度辅助讲解论文。
summaries.en: An agent plugin for Chinese-speaking learners that extracts and parses English research papers in PDF or LaTeX form and provides structured explanations with optional figure analysis.

capabilities: Installs and updates a paper-reading agent preset
Scans workspace files for PDFs, LaTeX, figures, code, and data
Extracts PDF text and embedded figures
Writes extracted figures to the workspace
Optionally sends figures to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
